name: com.makemyqrcodes/qr-codes
title: Make My QR Codes
description: Make QR codes that keep working: free static codes, or changeable codes you can edit and track.

tools.name: create_static_code
tools.description: Make a QR code image without an account or key, saving nothing. The code holds the content itself (a web address, Wi-Fi login, text, email, phone number or text message), so it works forever without this site, but it can never be changed or counted after printing: tell the person that. Use create_code instead when the person has a key and wants a code they can point somewhere new later, or see scans for. Each type needs its own fields, named in each field's description. Web addresses are checked first: link shorteners, IP addresses and pages Google Web Risk flags are refused. At most 120 codes an hour per connection. Returns the image (SVG by default, best for print, or PNG 1200 px) and a scan test result.

type.description: What the code holds: url (a web address), wifi (a network login), text, email (a new email), phone (a call) or sms (a text message)

url.description: type "url": the web address the code opens, e.g. https://example.com/menu

wifi_password.description: type "wifi": password (leave out when wifi_security is "nopass")

wifi_security.description: type "wifi": WPA covers WPA2 and WPA3. Default WPA.

text.description: type "text": the message shown when scanned

email_to.description: type "email": address the new email goes to

phone_number.description: types "phone" and "sms": the number to call or text

sms_message.description: type "sms": text the message starts with

style.description: classic (square modules, default), rounded or dots

label.description: Optional label printed under the code, e.g. "Scan for Wi-Fi"

format.description: svg (default; vector, best for print) or png (1200 px)

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the account this key belongs to: how many changeable codes it has used and has left, its plans and when they renew, the plans on sale with yearly prices, the page where the person buys one (buy_at), and the folders in use. Call it before create_code when unsure there's room for another changeable code, after create_code fails for that reason, or to find folder names for list_codes. You can't buy plans: give the person the buy_at link. Wi-Fi, text, email, phone and SMS codes never use the allowance. Read only; works with any key.

tools.name: list_codes
tools.description: List the account's codes, newest first, with each one's id, name, folder, kind (changeable or static), what it holds or where it points, short link, status and all-time scans. Use it to find a code's id before get_code, update_code or download_code; use get_code for one code's scan stats and history. Filters combine: search matches part of the name, link ending or web address (not case sensitive); folder and status must match exactly. Returns up to limit codes from offset, and total; when there are more, call again with offset set to next_offset. No matches gives an empty list. Read only; works with any key.

search.description: Part of a code's name, link ending or web address; not case sensitive

folder.description: Only codes in this folder (exact name; get_account lists them)

status.description: Only active codes, paused ones (they show a "paused" page when scanned), or blocked ones (switched off for breaking the rules)

limit.description: How many codes to return, 1 to 100. Default 50

offset.description: How many matching codes to skip: next_offset from the last reply. Default 0

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Get one code's full details and scan stats: what list_codes shows, a contact card's fields, and for changeable codes the scans in the last 7, 30, 90 or 365 days (unique visitors, scans per day, countries, devices) and its last 10 changes, such as where it pointed before and pauses. Static codes have no stats: they can't be counted. Automated checks (link previews, bots) are left out of the numbers, and days are in UTC. Find the code with list_codes first if you don't know its id or link ending. Read only; works with any key.

code.description: The code: its id from list_codes, or a changeable code's link ending (e.g. "menu" for makemyqrcodes.com/menu)

days.description: Stats period in days: 7, 30, 90 or 365. Default 30

tools.name: download_code
tools.description: Download a print-ready file of one of the account's codes, in its saved design: SVG (default; vector, any size, best for print shops), PNG (size_px wide, 300 dpi) or a vector PDF sized to width_in inches. The file comes back as an embedded resource (SVG, PDF) or an image (PNG). For content that isn't saved in the account, use create_static_code instead. At most 120 files an hour per account. Read only; works with any key.

code.description: The code: its id from list_codes, or a changeable code's link ending (e.g. "menu" for makemyqrcodes.com/menu)

size_px.description: PNG only: width in pixels, 200 to 2000. Default 1200

width_in.description: PDF only: printed width in inches, 0.5 to 40. Default 2

tools.name: create_code
tools.description: Save a new code in the account and return its id, short link and a scan test. "url" (website link) and "vcard" (contact card) make changeable codes: they hold a short makemyqrcodes.com link, can be pointed somewhere new after printing, count their scans, and each uses one of the account's changeable codes (get_account shows how many are left). wifi, text, email, phone and sms codes are static and always free. Each type needs its own fields, named in each field's description. Web addresses are checked first: link shorteners, IP addresses and pages Google Web Risk flags are refused. Calling it twice makes two codes. Needs a key that can make and change codes. Use download_code afterward for the print file; use create_static_code when there's no key or nothing needs saving.

type.description: url (website link) and vcard (contact card) are changeable; wifi, text, email, phone and sms are static

name.description: Shown in the account; made from the content if left out

folder.description: Folder to put it in, any name; a folder exists once a code is in it

ending.description: Changeable codes: a custom link ending (makemyqrcodes.com/<ending>), 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Random if left out. Can't be changed later.

url.description: type "url": the web address the code opens, e.g. https://example.com/menu

wifi_password.description: type "wifi": password (leave out when wifi_security is "nopass")

wifi_security.description: type "wifi": WPA covers WPA2 and WPA3. Default WPA.

text.description: type "text": the message shown when scanned

email_to.description: type "email": address the new email goes to

phone_number.description: types "phone" and "sms": the number to call or text

sms_message.description: type "sms": text the message starts with

contact.description: type "vcard": the contact card people save. Needs first, last or org.

design.description: How the code looks. All optional; dark squares on a light background scan best.

frame_text.description: the label, e.g. "Scan for the menu"

ecc.description: error correction; higher survives more damage

margin.description: blank border in squares (4 is safest)

tools.name: update_code
tools.description: Change one of the account's codes: where a website-link code points (destination), a contact card's details (contact, replacing the whole card), its name or folder, or pause and resume a changeable code (status). Only the fields you send change. A new destination or a pause applies to everyone who scans the printed code from then on, so confirm with the person first; both are recorded in the code's history (get_code shows it). A new destination goes through the same link checks as create_code. Codes can't be deleted, and a code locked by a lapsed plan can't be edited (it keeps working). Needs a key that can make and change codes. Returns the code as list_codes shows it, plus which fields changed.

code.description: The code: its id from list_codes, or a changeable code's link ending (e.g. "menu" for makemyqrcodes.com/menu)

destination.description: Website-link codes: the new web address

contact.description: Contact cards: the full new card (replaces the old one; needs first, last or org)

name.description: New name shown in the account; an empty string makes one from the content

folder.description: Move it to this folder, any name; an empty string takes it out of its folder

status.description: paused shows a "paused" page when scanned; active resumes it. Changeable codes only
